It's been fine Autumn for Gabby Collison.  Coming off the track with a trio of sub-10 minutes 3,000m races and a 16:52.1 5,000m at Crawley in September, she then transferred her attentions to the road.
The Great South Run at Portsmouth saw her unleash a marvellous 57:57 to remove over 2½ minutes from the Club Record for 10 miles and two weeks later her season's best for 10k came down to 35:50 at Basingstoke's Klix '6'.  The AAA and Inter-County 10k Championship was held at Barnsley on November 2nd and representing Surrey she improved again to 35:22 for a superb 8th place in this top class race.  A win at one of her local events at Preston Park came seven days later and was followed on November 16th by 1st place in the Brighton & Hove 10k in 34:46 – just 14 seconds short of her own and Belgrave's best ever performance set in 1995.  Then on to the Victory '5' at Portsmouth where another of her marks from 1995 barely survived as she clocked 27:57 for the 5 mile course.

It was great to see Gabby Collison back in the team and running away from good class opposition in the 3000m to score a notable win while Judy Oakley made it a double for the Belles by taking 'B' race as well.
